**Other information:**

Adds the `seat:start` npm script requested in #20429: a new `buildScripts/util/seatStart.mjs` entry point that calls the existing `ensureDevelopmentThemeAssets()` seam. It runs the canonical non-interactive development build (`npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all`) only when `inspectDevelopmentThemeAssets()` reports `ready: false`, and otherwise logs that the assets are current and exits 0 immediately — no second freshness check is added. The entry point follows the repo pattern (`isEntryModule` gate, injectable `repoRoot` option like its `buildScripts/` siblings).

Verification (fresh clone without `npm install`, so the builder itself could not run end-to-end):
- Current checkout (sandbox repo root with complete, fresh `dist/development/css` + `theme-map.json`): `runSeatStart()` exits 0 without invoking the build ("development theme assets are current — nothing to build").
- Stale checkout (one SCSS source touched newer than its CSS): `runSeatStart()` invokes `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all` and exits non-zero when the builder fails, with the recovery hint.
- `node --check` clean; `npm run seat:start` wiring confirmed.

The remaining acceptance criterion (a full Fleet restart of a stale seat showing `seatStart: {state: 'ran'}`) is post-merge by definition and needs the Fleet harness from neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1480.

AI assistance: this change was implemented with the help of an AI coding agent on behalf of the account owner (wanjinhao1).
